notes: Fires when the user wants clean-code principles or refactor guidance (SRP/DRY/KISS/naming/function rules). Boundary routes active diff/PR reviews to review-code.

evals.prompt: Refactor this UserService — it has 150-line functions, deep nesting, and magic numbers everywhere. Clean it up.
evals.expected_output: Applies clean-code principles: splits functions to one-thing, replaces magic numbers with named constants, flattens nesting with guard clauses/early returns, and fixes naming; optionally records an ADR-clean-code-<date>.md decision log.

evals.prompt: Help me establish clean coding standards and naming conventions for our new codebase.
evals.expected_output: Presents the clean-code principles (SRP, DRY, KISS, YAGNI, fail-fast), naming rules (booleans/functions/constants/collections), and function rules (one thing, max 3 params, no flag params) as reusable standards guidance.

evals.prompt: Review this PR diff for bugs and security issues and give me a PASS/FAIL verdict.
evals.expected_output: Should route to review-code / not fire, because the user wants an active review of a specific diff producing findings and a verdict — clean-code covers principles and refactor guidance, not reviewing a specific diff or PR.
